extracted.name: Kale and Quinoa Salad
extracted.description: Kale, quinoa, currants, pecans, and feta cheese are tossed in a basic vinaigrette in this salad recipe.
ingredient_lines: 10 leaves kale, cut into small pieces
instruction_lines: Bring water to a boil in a saucepan; stir in quinoa. Reduce heat to medium-low, cover saucepan, and cook until water absorbed, about 12 minutes. Remove saucepan from heat, let rest, covered, for 5 minutes. Remove cover; allow quinoa to cool completely.
Add kale to a large mixing bowl. Whisk olive oil, lemon juice, Dijon mustard, garlic, pepper, and salt together in a separate bowl until emulsified; drizzle over kale.
Add cooled quinoa, pecans, currants, and feta cheese to dressed kale; toss to combine.
